abilities.name: Cold Front
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when you or an allied Tamer or Digimon within 3 spaces of you is attacked, you may use your Free Action to subtract 1d8 from the damage they take.

abilities.name: Solo Run
abilities.description: Whenever your Digimon is the only Digimon currently active on your side, they gain a bonus to all attack rolls and damage rolls equal to your Friendship rank.

abilities.name: Pack Bond
abilities.description: Whenever you use Cold Front, the allied Digimon it protects gains a bonus to their next damage roll against the attacking Digimon equal to whatever was rolled for Cold Front.

abilities.name: Stronger Together
abilities.description: Whenever you use Cold Front, add your Friendship rank to the amount rolled.

abilities.name: Stand Together
abilities.description: Cold Front can now target any allied Digimon anywhere on the battlefield, not just within 3 spaces. You can use Cold Front once per round instead of once per encounter.

abilities.name: Warp Digivolution
abilities.description: Your Digimon can now digivolve two stages at once in a single Digivolving Action, skipping the stage in between. Pay the combined Hope cost of both stages minus 2 to initiate the Warp Digivolution. While Warp Digivolved, your Digimon's Hope cost per Tamer turn is equal to the combined Hope cost of the two stages minus 2. For example, if your Digimon digivolves from Rookie to Ultimate, the normal Hope cost is Champion (6) plus Ultimate (10) for 16 Hope per Tamer turn; with Warp Digivolution the cost is 14 Hope per Tamer turn. Warp Digivolution cannot be forced, the full initiation cost must always be paid, and all other digivolution rules apply normally.
